targets.rule: census.csv rows with every evidence column 'no' and order number below 5076; lettered and half orders count by their number

wpa_numbered_list.what: WPA Historical Records Survey, Presidential Executive Orders, Numbered 1-8030 (1944), parsed by the wpa-lists job. Only the date, the summary and the citations are used, to recognise an order in a book. A target the parse lacks (half orders and a few others) can be found only by number.
